It is highly auspicious for the support of the practitioner. The common supports of the Sutra and Mantra systems are as follows: <term>Nama du sarba bhudha dhe bhya. Om nam samandha bhudha nan.</term> <note>Salutations to all Buddhas. Om, salutations to the universal Buddhas.</note> For the crown: <term>Vajra ho hum phat svaha.</term> <term>Am tram yam dhe. Sarba tathagata hridaya. Garbe jala dhama dhatu garbe. Samhara ayu. Samshoraya. Papam sarba tatha hridaya.</term> <note>Heart of all Tathagatas. Womb of the water of the Dharma realm. Gather life. Purify. Sins of the heart of all Tathagatas.</note> For the hair: <term>Samanta tathagato shincha bimala.</term> <note>Universal pure sprinkling of the Tathagatas.</note> For the brain: <term>Vishuddhe svaha.</term> <note>Completely purified.</note> <term>Om ruru tista siddhi lochana. Sarba atta padha svaha.</term> For the eyes: <term>Vajra ho hum ah.</term> For the <term>urna</term> <gloss>the tuft of hair between the brows</gloss>: <term>Vajra hari svaha.</term> For the eyebrows: <term>Vajra dhoda svaha.</term> For the ears: <term>Vajra tisabya gataye svaha.</term> For the nose: <term>Vajra ho hum svaha. Vajre hosti svaha.</term> For the tongue: <term>Vajra hara svaha.</term> For the neck: <term>Vajra hari svaha.</term> For the throat: <term>Vajra hori svaha.</term> For the two armpits: <term>Vajra horongpa svaha.</term> For the heart: <term>Vajra harera svaha.</term> For the two hands: <term>Vajra ho bam ho svaha.</term> For the right ribs: <term>Vajra ho bam bhi svaha.</term> For the left ribs: <term>Vajra ho shushu ya svaha.</term> For the navel: <term>Vajra ho abham svaha.</term> For the secret place <note>the genitals</note>: <term>Vajra ho paye svaha.</term> For the two feet: <term>Vajram phuyu e svaha.</term> For the calves: <term>Vajra garba bhe svaha.</term> For the flesh: <term>Om bhid svaha.</term> For the fingers and toes: may all be made auspicious by the <term>ye dharma</term> <gloss>the mantra of dependent origination</gloss>. Beneath the feet, place the wheel of the male and female <term>yakshas</term> <gloss>nature spirits</gloss>.

<leaf-break/>

The prayer for the bath is: Hum! Within the stainless crystal vase, filled with the water of mirror-like wisdom, by bathing the body of the Victorious One, may the hatred of all beings be purified. Hum! <term>Vajra jñana shuddho ah.</term> <note>Vajra wisdom is pure.</note> When the support of the Victorious One's body has been touched by the stains of afflictions, by wiping the body with stainless white silk, may the obscurations be purified so that wisdom may dwell, and may it be firmly consecrated within this support. <term>Vajra pam shuddhe ah.</term> Hum! Within the stainless golden vase, filled with the water of the wisdom of equality, by bathing the body of the Victorious One, may the pride of all beings be purified. <term>Tram ratna jñana shuddhe ah.</term> Hum! If the body of the Victorious One is touched by the pollution of garments, by wiping the body with stainless yellow silk, may the obscurations be purified so that wisdom may dwell, and may it be firmly consecrated within this support. <term>Ratna pam shuddhe ah.</term> Hum! Within the stainless copper vase, filled with the water of discriminating wisdom, by bathing the body of the Victorious One, may the attachment of all beings be purified. <term>Hri padma vajra jñana shuddhe ah.</term> Hum! If the body of the Victorious One is touched by the pollution of broken vows, by wiping the body with stainless red silk, may the obscurations be purified so that wisdom may dwell, and may it be firmly consecrated within this support. <term>Padma pam shuddhe ah.</term> Hum! Within the precious silver vase, filled with the water of all-accomplishing wisdom...

<leaf-break/>

...emanating sparks. From his orange-red hair swirling upward, a green horse head neighs, the sound of the horse reaching the ten directions. He wears a crown of skulls, the precious life-force. In his right hand, a curved knife is raised toward the sky. In his left hand, a skull-cup of blood seethes with waves. He wears a lion and elephant hide and a human skin fluttering on his body. He wears a tiger-skin skirt and is adorned with a necklace of snakes and skulls. Upon a seat of the union of male and female enemies and obstructors, he stands with two legs, one extended and one tucked in a majestic posture. From the heart syllable <term>Hri</term>, light rays radiate to the ten directions. The Great Wrathful One's anger fills the sky. The Wrathful Mother's anger fills the earth. Their non-dual anger fills the space between. All without exception is stirred like white clouds. The messengers of activity fill the three thousandfold world system. You hosts of obstructors who would harm this support, do not stay in this place; depart elsewhere! If you do not go, you will surely be crushed to dust. You hosts of spirits, depart at once! <term>Om vajra krodha padma haya griva hulu hulu.</term> <note>original: "rta (kri hya wa) ghi ba"</note> <term>Harmful spirits uchata ah hum phat.</term> Thus, by scattering the consecrated substances, the obstructors are expelled. Then, perfume it with fragrant incense. Garments and ornaments...
